description: RFC 8621 §7.2 marks sendAt as (immutable; server-set). The server must always set sendAt to the time the EmailSubmission was created (or the FUTURERELEASE time based on envelope parameters). process_create() in submission.rs reads sendAt directly from the client-supplied create_args (lines 791-800) and uses it as the submission time. Trigger: client sends {"sendAt": "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z", ...} in EmailSubmission/set create. Bad behavior: server stores the client-supplied future date as sendAt instead of the actual creation time, violating the server-set constraint.
title: sendAt is server-set but code accepts client value on EmailSubmission create
